differences.a_observable: The background cards are out of focus due to a shallow depth of field.
differences.b_observable: The entire scene, including background cards, is in sharp focus.
differences.fix: Enable depth of field on the camera and adjust the aperture.

differences.a_observable: The shadow beneath the blue card is soft and highly diffused.
differences.b_observable: The shadow beneath the blue card is sharp and dark.
differences.fix: Increase the size of the light source to soften the contact shadows.

differences.a_observable: The corners of the frame are darkened by a vignette.
differences.b_observable: The corners of the frame are bright and evenly lit.
differences.fix: Add a vignette pass in post-production.

differences.a_observable: The blue card has a slightly desaturated, matte appearance.
differences.b_observable: The blue card is highly saturated and bright.
differences.fix: Adjust the material color and saturation of the blue card.

json.highest_impact_fix: Adjust the camera's focal length and position to match the reference perspective, and enable depth of field to replicate the background blur.
